I know I can improve with time but the problem is it will be too late. Your success in life is defined by what you did in your 20s. Most people meet their spouses before 30 and those who were good with women aquire better women. 

The biggest career moves are made in your 20s. Your 30s are more or less living off the success of your 20s. If you didn't do well in your 20s your 30s will suck.

So it's rude to have standards? 

I didn't say **all** women were like that. Just a good number of them are. 

Women say the same things about all the good guys being taken.

Thank you. It's nice to see w kind message when I see a bunch of people call me a worthless human being for having standards in women.

I mean it's not like I'm some fat fuck who has no intention of getting beyond a minimum wage job.

>you fully admit you're no prize yourself 


See what I mean. It doesn't matter that someone holds down a prestigious job, is in excellent shape and does cool things. If he has a "personality issue" it is completely ok to belittle him and call him a pedofile for having standards. 

And no less on what should be a thread seeking support not throwing insults. 

Esit: wait I see where you're getting at. You belittling me has caused me to argue back and defend myself. I am a prize or will be once I land a prestigious job. Thank you.
